{
  "replace_all": false,

  "old_string": "await probe('B1 multi-word settled', 2.3);",
  "new_string": "/**\n * Full-beat sweep: for EVERY frame, record the painted gap of every adjacent same-line word pair where BOTH\n * words are materially visible (opacity >= 0.35). A gap that only exists while a word is a ghost is not a\n * gap the viewer can see; a gap between two visible words is.\n */\nasync function sweep(label: string, from: number, to: number) {\n  const rows = await page.evaluate(([f, t, fps]) => {\n    const out: { frame: number; gaps: number[] }[] = [];\n    for (let i = Math.round(f * fps); i < Math.round(t * fps); i++) {\n      (window as any).applyFrame(i, 270);\n      const beatEl = document.getElementById('beat')!;\n      const spans = (Array.from(beatEl.getElementsByClassName('w')) as HTMLElement[])\n        .filter((s) => getComputedStyle(s).display !== 'none')\n        .filter((s) => parseFloat(s.style.opacity || '1') >= 0.35);\n      const items = spans.map((s) => {\n        const r = s.getBoundingClientRect();\n        const bleed = (parseFloat(getComputedStyle(s).webkitTextStrokeWidth) || 0) / 2;\n        return { l: r.left - bleed, r: r.right + bleed, top: Math.round(r.top / 10) };\n      });\n      const byLine = new Map<number, typeof items>();\n      for (const it of items) { if (!byLine.has(it.top)) byLine.set(it.top, []); byLine.get(it.top)!.push(it); }\n      const gaps: number[] = [];\n      for (const its of byLine.values()) {\n        its.sort((a, b) => a.l - b.l);\n        for (let k = 1; k < its.length; k++) gaps.push(+(its[k].l - its[k - 1].r).toFixed(2));\n      }\n      out.push({ frame: i, gaps });\n    }\n    return out;\n  }, [from, to, FPS] as [number, number, number]);\n\n  const all = rows.flatMap((r) => r.gaps);\n  if (!all.length) { console.log(`\\n### ${label}: no visible word pairs`); return; }\n  const mn = Math.min(...all), mx = Math.max(...all);\n  const worst = rows.filter((r) => r.gaps.some((g) => g === mx || g === mn))[0];\n  console.log(`\\n### SWEEP ${label} \u2014 ${rows.length} frames, ${all.length} visible word-pair samples`);\n  console.log(`    painted gap min=${mn}px  max=${mx}px  SPREAD=${(mx - mn).toFixed(2)}px`);\n  console.log(`    worst frame ${worst.frame}: gaps=[${worst.gaps.join(', ')}]`);\n}\n\nawait probe('B1 multi-word settled', 2.3);"
}
